Heirloom, Cross-Server, and Linking

A guide to rewards that can return in future eras, rewards that can work on listed worlds, and the account linking step used to deliver eligible cross-server items.

01

Heirlooms

Rewards that can be received again in later eligible eras

Heirloom means the item is treated as a long-term account reward. When an item is marked as heirloom, the player should expect to be able to receive it again in future eligible eras, instead of treating it as a normal one-season claim.

This is most important on seasonal worlds. When an era resets, regular seasonal progress can be wiped, but heirloom-marked items are meant to return through the eligible claim or delivery flow attached to that reward.

TermMeaning
HeirloomThe item can be received again in future eligible eras.
Non-heirloomThe item should be treated as limited to the current claim, event, world, or season unless stated otherwise.
Heirloom itemThe heirloom behavior belongs to that specific item. Other rewards from the same shop, box, or event do not automatically become heirlooms.
02

Cross-Server

Rewards that can benefit the account on mentioned worlds

Cross-server means the reward can benefit the same account on another available world listed for that reward. It does not mean every world automatically receives the item.

Always follow the wording attached to the item. If a cosmetic or item says it is cross-server for Legacy, Abaldar, or another specific world, those are the worlds included by that reward.

Reward wordingHow to read it
Cross-serverThe account can benefit from the reward beyond the original world, based on the listed available worlds.
Cross-server to LegacyThe reward can be received or used on Legacy when the account and item conditions are met.
Cross-server to selected worldsOnly the worlds specifically mentioned by the reward should be treated as included.
03

Account Linking

Connecting another world account for cross-server delivery

Account linking is part of the cross-server delivery flow. If you play on one world and the reward is available on another eligible world, the other world account may need to be linked first so the system knows where to deliver the item.

For example, if you are playing on Abaldar and a reward is available cross-server to Legacy, linking the Legacy account allows the eligible cosmetic or item to be received there.

  1. Check the item text to confirm it is cross-server and which worlds are included.
  2. Link the other world account when delivery is needed outside the world where the reward was obtained.
  3. Claim on the eligible world after the account link and reward conditions are complete.
04

Heirloom vs Cross-Server

Future-era ownership and world availability are different rules

Heirloom and cross-server are related account-level terms, but they control different things. A reward can be heirloom, cross-server, both, or neither.

RuleControlsExample meaning
HeirloomFuture era availabilityThe item can be received again in the next eligible era.
Cross-serverWorld availabilityThe account can benefit from the item on another mentioned world.
Account linkingDelivery connectionThe other world account is connected so the eligible reward can be delivered there.
05

Legacy and Abaldar

World rules can change how a reward behaves

Legacy and Abaldar can handle cosmetic-style rewards differently. Legacy may include cosmetic bonuses on some items, while Abaldar is usually more careful with accumulated power because it is seasonal.

Follow the item wording for the world you are claiming on. If an item lists a Legacy effect, do not assume that same effect exists on Abaldar unless the item itself says so.
